title: Characterization of failed configuration decoding
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, Boolean input $x$, and natural numbers $s,c$, decoding $c$ at window size $s$ returns no configuration if and only if there is no configuration for input $x$ whose work-tape heads lie within distance $s$ of the origin, whose work tapes are blank outside that window, and whose code at window size $s$ is $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine N
